forbidden: calling any M22/M23 transport or bank-service tick a cycle
claiming DRAMsim3 timing, FPS, energy, or paper PPA
claiming L16 versus 96-MAC as same logic resource
claiming Local5 attention is zero or reporting Local5 system speedup
direct numeric speedup versus Prosperity or Phi without adapters
permitted: legal SRAM-bounded spill/replay tiling with dynamic-BN barriers
M4/M7/M21 cycle-defined compute envelopes and explicit correction
same-interface baseline gap matrix and 2x requirement equations

highest_value_next_rtl.name: M25A_RESOURCE_SHARED_ATLIF_M4_LANE_CLUSTER
highest_value_next_rtl.objective: time-share the existing 96 arithmetic lanes between M4 reduction/output and ATLIF slot service, with a barrier-indexed tile DMA/replay controller and a one-entry M21 result snapshot queue that removes six last-packet bubbles
highest_value_next_rtl.required_proof: VCS exact ordered replay, DC area-constrained A/B at one frequency, and address-timed SRAM/DRAM schedule; do not implement three-slice/FIFO40 first
highest_value_next_rtl.why: it attacks the same-logic blocker and the only newly identified implemented bubble, while keeping the M4 source-owned object and dynamic-BN barrier

paper_headline_blockers: L16 uses 160 ATLIF multipliers versus the declared 96-MAC baseline
L8 is below the ATLIF multiplier budget but does not cross 2x
L10 is the nearest discrete point at or above 96 but uses 100 multipliers and is DSE-only
M4 plus M21 logic area is not matched to Fixed/RQTB
M23 is not DRAMsim3 timing and H67 attention traffic is an abstract lower bound
Prosperity and Phi-like same-workload adapters are missing

effective_m4_speed_rebind.reason: charge the later M4 temporal-fenced one-cycle Motion RMW evidence

schedule: operator_begin: clear one-slice channel-resident M21 moment banks
first pass, for each output/lane state tile: DMA state, execute M4 source-owned tile, enqueue exact 96-channel packets, and drain FIFO4 while moments persist
after the final first-pass tile only: retire all six registered 16-lane result subtiles and generate dynamic-BN coefficients exactly once
second pass, for each tile: replay/materialize normalized output into ATLIF
release the operator barrier only after every second-pass tile retires
legal_tilings.working_set_separation: tile SRAM is bounded here; M23 boundary-materialized working set remains DRAM, never an on-chip macro claim
